en.title: Daily Action Flow, September 17, 2026
en.description: Eight source-ordered actions separate evidence, compute credit and execution authority.
en.centralJudgment: Financeability depends on contracts, residual value and repayment. Publication completes a research framework; it does not execute the source’s financial proposals.
en.fieldLine: Eight signals. One compute-credit framework. Evidence before execution.

actions.title: Specify an agent incident ledger
actions.why: Model Olympics can evaluate which models conceal failure, recover lawfully, consume Robin’s time and retain lessons—not merely which model scores highest.
steps: Create Agent Incident Ledger v0 with trigger, unauthorized behavior, blast radius, detection, recovery, Robin-intervention minutes and recurrence fields; backfill one existing Model Olympics failure.
Record trigger, unauthorized behavior, blast radius, detection, recovery, Robin minutes and recurrence; use one verified historical case only under separate project authority.
actions.done: READY; specification recorded, no Model Olympics ledger or backfill changed.

actions.title: Watch Planted deployment economics
actions.why: “Bring your own power plus automated deployment” could become a new packaged asset for securing sites, permits and compute customers.
steps: Classify Planted as INVESTIGATE—deployment economics; track all-in cost per MW, field hours, robot utilization, downtime, project margin and realized 28 MW output rather than underwriting its 20 GW pipeline.
Require all-in cost per MW, field hours, utilization, downtime, margin and actual output. A 20 GW pipeline is not revenue.
actions.done: WATCHING; realized deployment economics UNKNOWN.

actions.title: Monitor five complete ETF sessions
actions.why: This should regulate the speed of BTC/ETH accumulation, not overturn the long-duration token-rails thesis.
steps: Keep DCA at the normal 1.0× rate rather than moving immediately to the cold-market 1.5×; accelerate only after five complete sessions of stabilizing combined flows and no further structural BTC break.
Preserve the source’s 1.0× and 1.5× proposal as a watch rule; require five complete flow sessions and an explicit structural-price criterion before any independently authorized execution.
actions.done: WATCHING; no DCA or portfolio setting changed and no trade executed.

actions.title: Prepare the Arc and Base comparison
actions.why: MerchantOS can treat Arc as another route without surrendering its customer relationship, business rules or reconciliation layer to Circle.
steps: Execute the same 20 USDC test payments on Arc and Base, comparing realized fees, finality, wallet compatibility, failure recovery, exports and reconciliation before admitting Arc to MerchantOS routing.
Design 20 matched payments per network with fees, finality, compatibility, recovery, exports and reconciliation. No wallet use or live payment is authorized by this publication.
actions.done: READY; comparison requirements archived, no payments or integration changes made.

actions.title: Publish compute-credit underwriting
actions.why: Robin’s rare position is interpreting both technical residual value and capital structure—not operating the data center.
steps: Publish When AI Chips Become Collateral with its complete four-language argument, compute-credit map and archived LinkedIn derivative; the full source assignment remains in the Briefing.
Confirm the five-word title, 2,000–3,500 English words, four full editions, evidence diagram, ledger and archived derivative; distinguish commitments, reporting and scenarios.
actions.done: COMPLETE for the article, four editions, original diagram and archived derivative; public release is verified by the publication receipt.

actions.title: Prepare the one-page Crux memo
actions.why: Robin’s career lane is AI Infrastructure Capital / Compute Credit / Strategic Underwriting: technical diligence combined with executive and buy-side capital judgment—not a return to data-center engineering.
steps: Produce a one-page Crux Compute-Credit Memo covering capital stack, collateral, counterparties, utilization, chip depreciation, refinancing and stress cases as an investment/advisory credential.
Record capital, collateral, counterparties, utilization, depreciation, refinancing and stress fields with explicit unknowns; application or outreach requires separate authority.
actions.done: COMPLETE for the local one-page memo; credit judgment HOLD, missing terms UNKNOWN, no delivery or application claimed.

actions.title: Watch Impulse contract conversion
actions.why: This merits relationship-building and contract-to-revenue monitoring, not chasing secondary shares on SpaceX enthusiasm.
steps: WATCH; do not chase secondaries. Upgrade to INVESTIGATE only with contract prepayments, mission margins, launch dependencies, manufacturing cadence, insurance, preference stack and an accessible price.
Require prepayments, mission margin, launch dependencies, manufacturing cadence, insurance, preference rights and an accessible price.
actions.done: WATCHING; no secondary purchase, contact or allocation sought.

actions.title: Separate Arc adoption from CRCL returns
actions.why: Circle’s strategy can be right while CRCL’s price is wrong. Technology adoption, corporate earnings and shareholder returns require separate ledgers.
steps: Do not buy the CRCL dip until Circle discloses Arc mainnet payment volume, incremental USDC demand, network fees, validator compensation and ARC-token economics.
Use corrected -6.78% CRCL and +0.03% QQQ returns; require payment volume, USDC increment, fees, validator compensation and token economics before reconsidering the source thesis.
actions.done: WATCHING; no position change.

zh-Hans.title: 每日行动流，2026年9月17日
zh-Hans.description: 八项行动依来源排序，分开证据、算力信用与执行权限。
zh-Hans.centralJudgment: 能否融资取决于合同、残值和偿债能力。发布完成一项研究框架，不执行源稿里的金融建议。
zh-Hans.fieldLine: 八个信号。一份算力信用框架。先取证，再执行。

actions.title: 明确代理事故台账字段
actions.why: 这正是Model Olympics可以拥有的独立价值：不只比较模型谁更聪明，而是比较谁会隐瞒、谁能合法恢复、谁需要Robin介入，以及错误有没有进入组织记忆。
steps: 在Model Olympics建立Agent Incident Ledger v0，每次记录触发条件、越权行为、影响范围、检测方式、恢复路径、Robin介入分钟及是否在下一轮复现；先回填一个已有失败案例。
记录触发、越权、影响范围、检测、恢复、Robin分钟数与复现；回填历史案例须另有项目权限及证据。
actions.done: READY；已记录字段，未修改Model Olympics台账或回填。

actions.title: 观察Planted部署经济性
actions.why: 数据中心缺电不一定先等电网扩建；“自带电力＋自动部署”可能成为获得土地、许可与客户合同的新型组合资产。
steps: 将Planted列为INVESTIGATE—deployment economics，只追踪每MW总成本、现场工时、机器人利用率、故障停工、项目毛利及28MW项目的实际发电表现，暂不因20GW管线或融资背书升级投资判断。
要求每MW总成本、现场工时、利用率、停机、毛利和实发电；20GW管线不等于收入。
actions.done: WATCHING；实际部署经济性UNKNOWN。

actions.title: 监测五个完整ETF交易日
actions.why: 对你的BTC/ETH长期仓位，这是调整买入节奏的温度信号，不是推翻长期Token轨道判断的证据。
steps: DCA维持1.0×正常档而非立即升至冷市1.5×；只有五个完整交易日ETF合计流量稳定、且BTC未出现进一步结构性破位后才提高部署速度。
将1.0×与1.5×保留为源稿观察规则；先看五个完整交易日和明确价格结构条件，金融执行另须授权。
actions.done: WATCHING；未改DCA或持仓设置，未交易。

actions.title: 准备Arc与Base比较
actions.why: MerchantOS未来可以把Arc视为一条可选轨道，但不能因为Circle拥有完整叙事就把业务逻辑、客户关系和对账控制权交给它。
steps: 用同一个测试钱包在Arc与Base各完成20笔USDC付款，比较真实Gas、最终确认、钱包兼容、失败恢复、交易导出和对账难度，再决定Arc是否进入MerchantOS路由候选。
设计每条网络20笔同条件付款，比较费用、确认、兼容、恢复、导出与对账；本次发布不授权使用钱包或付款。
actions.done: READY；比较要求已归档，未付款或改集成。

actions.title: 发布算力信用承销框架
actions.why: 这是你最稀缺的交叉位置——懂技术残值，又懂项目融资、资本循环与投资者叙事；不是去运营机房，而是解释这类新信用资产应该如何承销。
steps: 发布《当AI芯片成为抵押品》四语全文、算力信用图和归档LinkedIn稿；完整任务保留于简报。
核实五词标题、2,000–3,500英文词、四语全文、证据图、台账与归档衍生稿；分开承诺、报道和场景。
actions.done: 文章、四语稿、原创图与归档衍生稿COMPLETE；公开发布由发布回执验证。

actions.title: 完成一页Crux备忘录
actions.why: 你的职业机会在AI Infrastructure Capital / Compute Credit / Strategic Underwriting：用工程背景检查资产真实性，用总裁和买方视角配置资本与关系，而不是重新成为数据中心工程师。
steps: 制作一页Crux Compute-Credit Memo，列明资本栈、抵押品、合同对手方、利用率、芯片折旧、再融资路径和压力情景，把它作为面向基础设施基金、银行或前沿实验室的投资／顾问作品。
列出资本、抵押、对手方、利用率、折旧、再融资和压力字段，未知项明确保留；投递或联系另需权限。
actions.done: 本地一页备忘录COMPLETE；信用判断HOLD，未披露条款UNKNOWN，未投递或申请。

actions.title: 观察Impulse订单转化
actions.why: 这是值得建立关系和跟踪订单转收入的公司，但不是因SpaceX IPO外溢热情就追高二级份额的机会。
steps: WATCH，不追二级——只有取得合同对应预付款、任务毛利、发射依赖、制造节拍、保险安排、优先权与可参与价格后，才升级为INVESTIGATE。
要求预付款、任务毛利、发射依赖、制造节奏、保险、优先权和可参与价格。
actions.done: WATCHING；未购买二级份额、联系或寻求配额。

actions.title: 分开Arc采用与CRCL回报
actions.why: 你可以认可Circle的战略，同时拒绝为尚未披露的经济模型买单。技术采用、公司收入和股票回报是三套不同账本。
steps: 暂不抄底CRCL；在Circle披露Arc主网支付量、USDC增量、网络费用、验证者补偿及ARC Token经济之前，不因“主网已上线”改变仓位。
采用更正后CRCL跌6.78%、QQQ涨0.03%的数据；判断前要求支付量、USDC增量、费用、验证者报酬及Token经济。
actions.done: WATCHING；未调整仓位。

actions.title: 一ページのCruxメモを完成
actions.why: AI Infrastructure Capital、Compute Credit、Strategic Underwritingが接点となる。技術検証と経営・買い手側の資本判断を組み合わせる。
steps: 資本構成、担保、契約相手、稼働率、減価、借換え、ストレスをまとめた一ページのCrux Compute-Credit Memoを作る。投資・助言能力を示す作品として用意し、送付や応募とは分ける。
資本、担保、顧客、稼働、減価、借換え、ストレスを並べ未知を明記。連絡や応募には別の権限が必要。

actions.title: Arc普及とCRCL収益を分ける
actions.why: Circleの戦略、企業収益、株主リターンは別々の台帳で評価できる。
steps: Arc本番決済量、USDC増分、ネットワーク手数料、バリデータ報酬、ARC経済の開示までは、メインネット開始だけを理由にCRCLの保有判断を変えない。
訂正後のCRCL6.78%安、QQQ0.03%高を使用。決済量、USDC増分、手数料、検証者報酬、トークン経済の開示を求める。
